sql:
with base as (
  select t.id as ticket_id, t.priority,
         sp.first_response_target_minutes,
         sp.resolution_target_minutes
  from tickets t
  join sla_policies sp on sp.id = t.sla_policy_id
  where t.created_at >= date '2025-01-01'
    and t.created_at < date '2026-01-01'
    and t.sla_policy_id is not null
),
breach_fr as (
  select ticket_id, avg(minutes_over) as minutes_over
  from sla_breaches
  where breach_kind = 'first_response'
  group by ticket_id
),
breach_res as (
  select ticket_id, avg(minutes_over) as minutes_over
  from sla_breaches
  where breach_kind = 'resolution'
  group by ticket_id
),
per_priority as (
  select
    b.priority::text as priority,
    count(*) as ticket_count_with_sla,
    round(avg(b.first_response_target_minutes)) as typical_first_response_target_minutes,
    round(avg(b.resolution_target_minutes)) as typical_resolution_target_minutes,
    round(100.0 * count(fr.ticket_id) / count(*), 1) as first_response_breach_rate,
    round(100.0 * count(res.ticket_id) / count(*), 1) as resolution_breach_rate,
    round(avg(fr.minutes_over)) as avg_minutes_over_first_response,
    round(avg(res.minutes_over)) as avg_minutes_over_resolution
  from base b
  left join breach_fr fr on fr.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
  left join breach_res res on res.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
  group by b.priority
),
overall as (
  select
    'All priorities'::text as priority,
    count(*) as ticket_count_with_sla,
    null::numeric as typical_first_response_target_minutes,
    null::numeric as typical_resolution_target_minutes,
    round(100.0 * count(fr.ticket_id) / count(*), 1) as first_response_breach_rate,
    round(100.0 * count(res.ticket_id) / count(*), 1) as resolution_breach_rate,
    round(avg(fr.minutes_over)) as avg_minutes_over_first_response,
    round(avg(res.minutes_over)) as avg_minutes_over_resolution
  from base b
  left join breach_fr fr on fr.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
  left join breach_res res on res.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
),
combined as (
  select 0 as sort_rank, * from overall
  union all
  select 1 as sort_rank, * from per_priority
)
select
  priority,
  ticket_count_with_sla,
  typical_first_response_target_minutes,
  typical_resolution_target_minutes,
  first_response_breach_rate,
  resolution_breach_rate,
  avg_minutes_over_first_response,
  avg_minutes_over_resolution
from combined
order by sort_rank, resolution_breach_rate desc nulls last, priority
note: Breach rate = share of in-scope tickets (created in 2025, sla_policy_id not null) with at least one sla_breaches row of that kind, across all tenants/currencies (rates and minute counts are currency-agnostic so no FX conversion needed). "Typical" target minutes per priority are averaged from the sla_policies rows actually attached to those tickets (ticket-weighted), not a flat lookup, since policies can vary by tenant.
